
func TestInProcessObserverLeaseCountsAndNonmutation(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	clock := &advanceableHostClock{now: time.Date(2026, 10, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	coordinator := &recordingSlotCapacityCoordinator{}
	owner := internalservice.New(clock, readySlotFacts{capacity: 2}, coordinator)
	identity := fmt.Sprintf("models_leases:%p", owner)
	t.Cleanup(func() { baselineobservation.Unregister(identity) })
	scope := mustRuntimeScopeRef(t, "observer-leases")
	acquire := func(name, holder string) models.ModelLease {
		t.Helper()
		result, err := owner.AcquireModelLease(t.Context(), models.AcquireModelLeaseRequest{Scope: scope, Name: name, Holder: holder})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return result.Lease
	}
	first := acquire("first", "one")
	second := acquire("first", "two")
	third := acquire("second", "three")
	snapshot, err := baselineobservation.CaptureOwner(identity)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	leases := snapshot.Leases
	if leases.LeaseRecordCount != 3 || leases.CapacityHoldersTotal != 3 || leases.CapacityHolders[scope.String()+"|FIRST"] != 2 || leases.CapacityHolders[scope.String()+"|SECOND"] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("actual integers: %#v", leases)
	}
	leases.CapacityHolders[scope.String()+"|FIRST"] = 99
	leases.LeaseRecords[0].Status = "mutated-copy"
	clock.now = clock.now.Add(2 * hostleases.DefaultLeaseTTL)
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		snapshot, err = baselineobservation.CaptureOwner(identity)
		if err != nil || snapshot.Leases.CapacityHoldersTotal != 3 {
			t.Fatalf("read mutated holders: %#v, %v", snapshot, err)
		}
		for _, record := range snapshot.Leases.LeaseRecords {
			if record.Status != string(models.ModelLeaseStatusActive) {
				t.Fatalf("read expired overdue lease: %#v", record)
			}
		}
	}
	if coordinator.released != 0 {
		t.Fatal("snapshot invoked coordinator")
	}
	// Restore the clock before explicit release, then let a real owner operation expire others.
	clock.now = clock.now.Add(-2 * hostleases.DefaultLeaseTTL)
	if _, err := owner.ReleaseModelLease(t.Context(), models.ReleaseModelLeaseRequest{Scope: scope, Lease: first.Lease}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	clock.now = clock.now.Add(2 * hostleases.DefaultLeaseTTL)
	if _, err := owner.GetModelLease(t.Context(), models.GetModelLeaseRequest{Scope: scope, Lease: second.Lease}); !errors.Is(err, models.ErrHostLeaseExpired) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	owner.(interface {
		RevokeModelLeases(models.RuntimeScopeRef, string)
	}).RevokeModelLeases(scope, third.ModelName)
	snapshot, err = baselineobservation.CaptureOwner(identity)
	if err != nil || snapshot.Leases.LeaseRecordCount != 3 || snapshot.Leases.CapacityHoldersTotal != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("retained state: %#v, %v", snapshot, err)
	}
	statuses := map[string]string{}
	for _, record := range snapshot.Leases.LeaseRecords {
		statuses[record.Key] = record.Status
	}
	if statuses[first.Lease.String()] != string(models.ModelLeaseStatusReleased) || statuses[second.Lease.String()] != string(models.ModelLeaseStatusExpired) || statuses[third.Lease.String()] != string(models.ModelLeaseStatusExpired) {
		t.Fatalf("retained statuses: %v", statuses)
	}
}

func TestInProcessObserverLeaseConcurrentReads(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	owner := internalservice.New(fixedHostClock{}, readySlotFacts{capacity: 2}, noopCoordinator{})
	identity := fmt.Sprintf("models_leases:%p", owner)
	t.Cleanup(func() { baselineobservation.Unregister(identity) })
	scope := mustRuntimeScopeRef(t, "observer-concurrent")
	done := make(chan struct{})
	var readers sync.WaitGroup
	readers.Add(1)
	go func() {
		defer readers.Done()
		for {
			select {
			case <-done:
				return
			default:
			}
			snapshot, err := baselineobservation.CaptureOwner(identity)
			if err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
				return
			}
			active := 0
			total := 0
			for _, record := range snapshot.Leases.LeaseRecords {
				if record.Status == string(models.ModelLeaseStatusActive) {
					active++
				}
			}
			for _, count := range snapshot.Leases.CapacityHolders {
				total += count
			}
			if active != total || total != snapshot.Leases.CapacityHoldersTotal || len(snapshot.Leases.LeaseRecords) != snapshot.Leases.LeaseRecordCount {
				t.Errorf("inconsistent owner state: %#v", snapshot)
				return
			}
		}
	}()
	for i := 0; i < 12; i++ {
		result, err := owner.AcquireModelLease(t.Context(), models.AcquireModelLeaseRequest{Scope: scope, Name: "model", Holder: "reader"})
		if err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			break
		}
		if _, err := owner.ReleaseModelLease(t.Context(), models.ReleaseModelLeaseRequest{Scope: scope, Lease: result.Lease.Lease}); err != nil {
			t.Error(err)
			break
		}
	}
	close(done)
	readers.Wait()
}
